title: Green Card Wait Planner
description: Model green card wait time by country of birth and preference category, estimate priority date progression, H-1B extension eligibility (AC21 §106), and career decision timing around the backlog.
data_vintage: 2026 — wait estimates based on historical DOS Visa Bulletin progression rates; actual dates move monthly and must be verified at travel.state.gov
regulatory_citations: INA §203 — employment-based preference visa numbers and per-country caps (7% rule)
AC21 §106(a) — H-1B extensions beyond 6 years if I-140 approved AND priority date not current
DOS Visa Bulletin — monthly priority date updates at travel.state.gov
8 CFR §204.5(e) — priority date portability under AC21 if same/similar occupation

mcp_tool_definition.name: plan_greencard_wait
mcp_tool_definition.description: Estimate green card priority date wait time, AC21 H-1B extension eligibility, and career decision timing based on country of birth and EB preference category.
